window: Covering reporting published since the Sept 6 edition, roughly Sept 4-7, with a few items surfacing late through indexing lag (a Golden Valley, MN meth bust dates to Aug 25; a Tipton County, TN lab raid dates to Aug 28). South America got dedicated effort in Spanish and Portuguese. Excluded: a Colombian National Police 'Operación Nexus' claim of 46.8 tonnes of cocaine and 26 captures, reported only by NTN24 and its syndication partners with no corroboration from El Tiempo, Semana, RCN or Infobae despite the scale it would represent — the same search turned up an unrelated outlet whose headline wrongly inflated the already-logged 4.7-tonne Zeus Arcano III operation to '46 toneladas,' which raises real doubt about the NTN24 figure too. Also excluded: a 280-lb/127 kg Laredo, TX CBP methamphetamine seizure (actually Aug 25) already considered and excluded as stale in the Sept 6 edition; a Zárate, Argentina cocaine-on-a-ship story that turned out to date to May; a CBP El Paso roundup that turned out to date to 2023; and a Pakistan ANF/DEA Colombo Port meth claim (671 kg) that appears to be a fuller accounting of the Sri Lanka seizure already logged Sept 1-2. No new SOUTHCOM strike or vessel interdiction was reported past the fourth Los Choneros refueling-vessel boarding already logged Sept 6.
